Question 13

What would be the system of equations for the following augmented matrix?

[023020322303]

a
{2y+3z=0x+3z=22x+3y=3
b
{2y+3z=02x+3z=22x+3y=3
c
{2y+3z=02x+3z=2x−3y=3
d
{y+3z=02x−3z=22x+3y=3
e
{2y−3z=02x+3z=22x+y=3
